summary: Tested new features for Cisa TI ITAM: Employees CRUD + typeahead, Assets typeahead, Deliveries/Returns with employee_id enrichment, Reports (preview + xlsx/pdf export), Dashboard KPI navigation with filters. All 27 backend tests passed and end-to-end UI flows are working.

issues: A11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' - add DialogDescription for accessibility

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to Radix DialogContent components to silence a11y warnings
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py: date filter for 'deliveries_by_employee_date' uses hard-coded '+00:00' suffix on $lte only; may miss deliveries stored with a different tz offset. Consider using naive ISO comparison or a proper datetime range.
assignments.py: when creating a delivery, if asset.status is 'reservado' or 'transito' it is not blocked (only 'asignado' is). Consider also rejecting non-'disponible' states.
reports.py returns_by_period does not require any date filter — a full-collection scan can be expensive; add mandatory from_date or pagination limit.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed departments, employees, assets, and one delivery+return; cleanup class soft-deletes employee & asset at end. UI test also seeded one TEST_UI_ department/employee/asset (left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covers: departments create/list, employees CRUD + duplicate-code guard + typeahead + department filter, assets typeahead by serial/mac/name, deliveries with employee_id (verifies status changes to 'asignado' and back to 'disponible' after return), reports categories/preview/export xlsx+pdf + invalid inputs. Frontend testids verified: nav-employees, nav-reports, employee-create-btn, employee-field-code/name/supervisor, employee-save-btn, employee-search-input, delivery-employee-typeahead, delivery-asset-typeahead, report-category-select, report-run-btn, report-export-xlsx, report-export-pdf, kpi-available (navigates to /activos?status=disponible).
